inspector.projectBody: Review the code and the tests, then write them to a review branch: they go on a Kanban card's branch, never into the project folder, and you open the pull request after reading the diff. A file that already exists is marked "replaces". You can also create a Kanban task: the agent will integrate the design in its own worktree, with build, tests and review.
